stemMd: Which sequence places these architectural contexts from earliest to latest?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Classical Athenian Acropolis; Hagia Sophia; Bauhaus

explanationMd: The Acropolis programme belongs to the fifth century BCE, Hagia Sophia to the sixth century CE, and the Bauhaus to the twentieth century. The sequence crosses ancient, Byzantine and modern contexts.

distractorRationale.d: Classical Athens precedes Byzantine Hagia Sophia.
distractorRationale.e: The Bauhaus is much later than Hagia Sophia.
distractorRationale.a: The ancient complex cannot be last.
